scope: Nine world-dam courses. Every displayed literal model result recomputed from its separate expression and matched to the visible model. This verifies arithmetic and units/boundaries reviewed by the author, not project-specific design approval. All 90 wrong-choice misconceptions were read as false beliefs. Model mechanisms use separate original extensions rather than copying failure paragraphs.

models.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳~Flood forecast bias account
models.boundary: 偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積~constant bias throughout the interval, omitting surface rainfall, evaporation and withdrawals; this is forecast error volume only

models.title: 分段庫容積分~Piecewise storage integration
models.boundary: 相鄰斷面的面積隨高程線性變化且假設靜水面；不是完整庫容曲線~area changes linearly with elevation between observations and the surface is level; this is not a complete capacity curve

models.title: 泥砂質量與淤積~Sediment mass and deposition
models.formula: Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3
models.boundary: 流量濃度及截留比例皆固定；不含床載、再懸浮及後續壓密~constant flow, concentration and trapping fraction; excludes bed load, resuspension and subsequent consolidation

models.title: 分層取水混溫~Layered withdrawal temperature mixing
models.formula: Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC
models.boundary: 兩水流密度比熱相同、完全混合且無外界熱交換；不代表生態合格溫度~equal density and heat capacity, complete mixing and no external heat exchange; not an ecological compliance temperature

models.title: 船閘用水時序~Lockage water timing
models.formula: A=4200 m2; dh=18 m; N=12 cycles/day; V=A*dh*N=907200 m3/day
models.boundary: 單獨閘室每次完全換水且無回收；不能乘上所有級數當作實際多級閘耗水~one isolated chamber exchanges a full volume each cycle without recovery; do not multiply by every stage to infer actual multistage consumption

models.title: 升船機平衡偏差~Ship lift balance imbalance
models.formula: dm=18000 kg; g=9.81 m/s2; v=0.08 m/s; eta=0.80 (dimensionless); P=dm*g*v/eta=17658 W
models.boundary: 僅算固定速度下不平衡重力功率，不含摩擦加速及制動冗餘~gravitational imbalance power at constant speed only; excludes friction, acceleration and braking redundancy

models.title: 淨水頭功率帳~Net head power account
models.formula: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW
models.boundary: 穩態不可壓縮流，效率為水力輸入至電端總效率；未計暫態及可用率~steady incompressible flow with overall hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency; transients and availability are excluded

models.title: 電力爬坡能量~Electrical ramp energy
models.boundary: 假設電端功率線性爬坡，不表示水力暫態或電網限制已獲滿足~linear electrical power ramp only; hydraulic transient and grid constraints are not thereby satisfied

models.title: 長庫區回水高差~Long reservoir backwater difference
models.formula: Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m
models.boundary: 坡度為無因次且只代表該時段兩站平均水面坡度；不是摩阻坡度定律~dimensionless slope represents the observed mean water-surface gradient between two stations in one interval, not a friction-slope law

models.title: 多感測殘差判讀~Multiple sensor residual diagnosis
models.formula: y=7.2 mm; yhat=5.4 mm; sigma=0.6 mm; z=(y-yhat)/sigma=3
models.boundary: 正常基線的標準差固定；數值僅示範殘差，並非本壩警報或安全判準~fixed standard deviation from an assumed baseline; the result illustrates a residual, not a project alarm or safety criterion

models.title: 拱座相容與分力~Abutment compatibility and load sharing
models.formula: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN
models.boundary: 線彈性且兩路徑同位移；未模擬三維拱殼、開裂或接觸滑移~linear elasticity and equal displacement in both paths; excludes three-dimensional shell action, cracking and contact slip

models.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓~Crack connectivity and uplift
models.formula: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN
models.boundary: 沿基底壓力線性且以一米壩長計算；不代表裂縫內實際壓力分布~linear basal pressure over a one-metre dam strip; not the measured distribution within an actual crack

models.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量~Concrete cooling heat account
models.formula: V=5000 m3; rho=2400 kg/m3; c=900 J/(kg*K); dT=8 K; E=V*rho*c*dT/1e9=86.4 GJ
models.boundary: 常數比熱與均勻溫降；未計持續水化熱及熱應力~constant heat capacity and uniform cooling; continuing hydration heat and thermal stress are excluded

models.title: 接縫閉合與溫度~Joint closure and temperature
models.formula: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=18 m; dT=12 K; dL=alpha*L*dT*1000=2.16 mm
models.boundary: 單一塊體沿量測方向自由膨脹；不是受約束接縫的實際閉合量~free expansion of one block along the measurement axis; not the actual closure of a restrained joint

models.title: 壓力鋼管水錘~Penstock water hammer
models.formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=0.7 m/s; dp=rho*a*dv/1e6=0.63 MPa
models.boundary: 速度變化快於相關往返波時間，單相彈性首波；未含汽穴與反射疊加~velocity change is faster than the relevant wave round-trip time; single-phase elastic first wave without cavitation or reflected-wave superposition

models.title: 溢洪面汽蝕指標~Spillway cavitation indicator
models.formula: pabs=85000 Pa; pv=2500 Pa; rho=1000 kg/m3; v=25 m/s; sigma=(pabs-pv)/(0.5*rho*v*v)=0.264
models.boundary: 使用局部平均絕對壓力；未給臨界汽蝕數或損傷速率~uses local mean absolute pressure; no critical cavitation value or erosion rate is supplied

models.title: 低水頭機組出力~Low head generating output
models.formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW
models.boundary: 淨水頭已扣引水損失且效率固定；未保證機組在該工況允許運行~net head already excludes conveyance loss and efficiency is fixed; operation at this point is not thereby authorized

models.title: 沉積三角洲前移~Sediment delta advance
models.boundary: 假設矩形沉積前緣且全數體積推進前緣；不含壓密及側向擴展~rectangular depositional front with all volume advancing that front; excludes consolidation and lateral spreading

models.title: 垂線監測溫漂~Pendulum monitoring thermal drift
models.formula: yraw=4.8 mm; k=0.04 mm/K; dT=15 K; ycorr=yraw-k*dT=4.2 mm
models.boundary: 儀器漂移係數由獨立校準取得且線性；未扣除壩體物理熱位移~instrument drift coefficient comes from independent linear calibration; actual thermal movement of the dam is not removed

models.title: 排水備援共同原因~Drainage redundancy common causes
models.formula: pA=0.03 (dimensionless); pB=0.04 (dimensionless); pBoth=pA*pB=0.0012
models.boundary: 兩泵同一需求期間的失效事件假設獨立；不是現場可靠度或年失效率~independent failure events over the same demand interval; not field reliability or an annual failure rate

models.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳~Irrigation pumping energy account
models.formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW
models.boundary: 揚程含全部假定水力損失，效率為電端至水力總效率；穩態計算~head includes assumed hydraulic losses and efficiency is overall electrical-to-hydraulic efficiency; steady operation

models.title: 發電抽水淨交換~Generation pumping net exchange
models.formula: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW
models.boundary: 所有功率同一時間與電端邊界，不另重扣已含於電表的損失~all powers use the same interval and electrical boundary; losses already included in readings are not deducted again

models.title: 前池水位緩衝~Forebay level buffering
models.formula: Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m
models.boundary: 面積固定且忽略波浪與側向取水；負號表示水位下降~constant surface area, no waves or lateral withdrawals; negative sign denotes falling level

models.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度~Conveyance friction scaling
models.boundary: 使用達西摩阻因子，穩態滿管且不含局部損失~Darcy friction factor, steady full-pipe flow, excluding local fitting losses

models.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳~Irrigation return flow accounting
models.boundary: 所有項目同一灌區邊界與日尺度，正儲存表示留在區內~all terms share one irrigation-area boundary and daily interval; positive storage remains within the area

models.title: 混凝土分塊溫差~Concrete block temperature mismatch
models.formula: alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain
models.boundary: 兩塊熱膨脹係數相同且只算自由應變差，不計徐變與約束~equal thermal expansion coefficients and free-strain difference only, excluding creep and restraint

models.title: 基礎排水阻力~Foundation drainage resistance
models.boundary: 線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量~linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge

models.title: 停機容量與水量~Outage capacity and water allocation
models.formula: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW
models.boundary: 所有剩餘機組相同出力且無共同限制，只算假想機組容量~equal output for remaining units and no shared constraints; hypothetical unit capacity only

models.title: 水準基準閉合~Level reference closure
models.boundary: 三段封閉測線的高差和，未給合格限值或誤差配賦規則~sum of height differences around a three-leg closed loop, without an acceptance limit or adjustment rule

models.title: 更新效率比較~Post renewal efficiency comparison
models.formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW
models.boundary: 同一淨水頭流量的效率差，未含可用率與全年水文分布~efficiency difference at identical net head and discharge; excludes availability and annual hydrologic distribution

models.title: 頻率極數與轉速~Frequency poles and speed
models.formula: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm
models.boundary: 理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌~ideal synchronous speed using total magnetic poles, not an Itaipu machine nameplate

models.title: 異頻換流能量~Asynchronous conversion energy
models.formula: Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh
models.boundary: 固定輸入及總傳輸效率，未計動態限制與停機~constant input and overall transfer efficiency, excluding dynamic limits and outages

models.title: 無功與視在容量~Reactive power and apparent capacity
models.formula: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW
models.boundary: 平衡正弦穩態且功率因數為實功除視在功率，不表示完整能力曲線~balanced sinusoidal steady state with power factor defined as active divided by apparent power, not a complete capability curve

models.title: 尾水抬升耦合~Tailwater rise coupling
models.boundary: 局部線性尾水評價，係數僅為假設且不含洪水回水遲滯~local linear tailwater relation with an assumed coefficient, excluding flood backwater hysteresis

models.title: 溢洪水舌動量~Spillway jet momentum
models.formula: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN
models.boundary: 穩態單一水平動量分量，控制面壓力另假設抵消；非完整消能池載重~steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load

models.title: 機組冷卻水熱升~Unit cooling water temperature rise
models.formula: Qheat=8000000 W; mdot=400 kg/s; cp=4180 J/(kg*K); dT=Qheat/(mdot*cp)=4.784688995 K
models.boundary: 穩態完全混合且熱負荷全由水帶走，不含對環境散熱~steady complete mixing with all stated heat carried by water and no ambient loss

models.title: 轉子激振頻率~Rotor excitation frequency
models.formula: n=90 rpm; blades=14; fpass=n/60*blades=21 Hz
models.boundary: 理想等距葉片通過頻率，不宣稱該頻率必定共振~ideal equally spaced blade-passing frequency, not a claim that resonance necessarily occurs

models.title: 跨境資料時間對齊~Cross border data time alignment
models.boundary: 固定流量下的時段錯配體積，不是實際漏水或永久庫容損失~volume assigned to the wrong interval at constant flow, not physical leakage or permanent storage loss

models.title: 機組輪替可用時數~Unit rotation available hours
models.formula: N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h
models.boundary: 只計假想設備可用台時，不計功率或水量限制~hypothetical equipment availability hours only, excluding power and water constraints

models.title: 閘門驅動功率~Gate drive power requirement
models.formula: F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W
models.boundary: 已知恆定提升力與速度，不含啟動峰值及不平衡吊點~known constant lifting force and speed, excluding startup peaks and unequal lifting points

models.title: 效率試驗不確定度~Efficiency test uncertainty
models.formula: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981
models.boundary: 各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間~dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval

models.title: 汽蝕可用水頭~Available cavitation head
models.formula: Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12
models.boundary: Hs為轉輪基準高於尾水的正值；只算假想可用係數，未提供所需係數~Hs is positive when the runner reference is above tailwater; hypothetical available coefficient only, with no required coefficient supplied

models.title: 低速巨型轉矩~Large torque at low speed
models.formula: P=600 MW; n=100 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=P*1e6/omega/1e6=57.29577951 MN*m
models.boundary: 恆速平均機械功率，不含電效率換算及動態扭矩峰值~constant-speed mean mechanical power, excluding electrical efficiency conversion and dynamic torque peaks

models.title: 轉子不平衡力~Rotor unbalance force
models.boundary: 剛性轉子單一不平衡量的力幅，未含支承傳遞與共振放大~force amplitude from one rigid-rotor unbalance, without support transmission or resonant amplification

models.title: 熱態軸線對心~Thermal operating alignment
models.boundary: 均溫自由伸長沿支承長度方向，非整個軸系實際偏移~uniform free extension along one support length, not the actual displacement of the entire shaft line

models.title: 局部熱阻與熱點~Local thermal resistance and hotspots
models.formula: Qheat=400000 W; Rth=0.00008 K/W; dT=Qheat*Rth=32 K
models.boundary: 穩態單一等效熱阻，熱流全部通過該路徑~steady single equivalent thermal resistance with all stated heat following that path

models.title: 疲勞循環累積~Fatigue cycle accumulation
models.boundary: 假設已給定兩級疲勞壽命與線性累積，非現場壽命保證~two assumed fatigue lives and linear accumulation, not a field life guarantee

models.title: 表面磨耗質量~Surface wear mass loss
models.formula: A=12 m2; dt=0.0008 m; rho=7800 kg/m3; dm=A*dt*rho=74.88 kg
models.boundary: 平均均勻厚度損失的體積近似，未描述局部坑蝕~volume approximation for mean uniform thickness loss, without describing local pitting

models.title: 檢測陽性與基率~Inspection positives and base rates
models.formula: prev=0.02 (dimensionless); sens=0.90 (dimensionless); spec=0.95 (dimensionless); PPV=prev*sens/(prev*sens+(1-prev)*(1-spec))=0.2686567164
models.boundary: 無因次機率且適用同一受檢群，假設靈敏度與特異度已知~dimensionless probabilities for the same inspected population, with sensitivity and specificity assumed known

models.title: 更新停機能量機會~Renewal outage energy opportunity
models.formula: Pcounter=300 MW; tout=18 h; Epotential=Pcounter*tout=5400 MWh
models.boundary: 假設原本能持續發電且無替代利用，只算反事實電量上界情境~assumes continuous counterfactual generation and no substitute water use; an upper scenario for displaced energy

models.title: 開挖卸荷彈性回復~Elastic rebound after excavation
models.formula: dsigma=2 MPa; E=15000 MPa; strain=dsigma/E*1e6=133.3333333 microstrain
models.boundary: 一維線彈性卸載應變幅度，未含節理張開及塑性損傷~one-dimensional linear elastic unloading strain magnitude, excluding joint opening and plastic damage

models.title: 方向剛度與傳力~Directional stiffness and load transfer
models.boundary: 均質線彈性岩柱沿單一軸向受力，不含拱座三維剪切~homogeneous linear elastic prism loaded along one axis, excluding three-dimensional abutment shear

models.title: 岩楔有效正向力~Rock wedge effective normal force
models.formula: N=20 MN; U=4 MN; mu=0.65 (dimensionless); C=2 MN; Tdrive=9 MN; FS=(mu*(N-U)+C)/Tdrive=1.377777778
models.boundary: 單一假想滑面且抗力參數固定，只是力比，不作安全核准~one assumed sliding plane with fixed resistance parameters; a force ratio, not safety approval

models.title: 降水位孔壓滯後~Pore pressure lag during drawdown
models.formula: h0=10 m; t=24 h; tau=24 h; hExcess=h0*exp(-t/tau)=3.678794412 m
models.boundary: 線性單一鬆弛模型的超額水頭，不是完整暫態滲流解~excess head in a linear single-relaxation model, not a full transient seepage solution

models.title: 地震慣性力尺度~Seismic inertia force scale
models.formula: m=120000000 kg; ah=0.15 (dimensionless); g=9.81 m/s2; F=m*ah*g/1e6=176.58 MN
models.boundary: ah為無因次重力加速度比例，假想單質量水平慣性尺度~ah is a dimensionless fraction of gravity; horizontal inertia scale for one assumed mass

models.title: 受約束溫升應力~Restrained heating stress
models.formula: E=25000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigmaC=E*alpha*dT=3 MPa
models.boundary: 單軸完全約束升溫的壓應力幅度，忽略徐變及彈性模數變化~compressive stress magnitude for uniaxial fully restrained heating, excluding creep and modulus change

models.title: 季節調蓄水量~Seasonal storage water balance
models.formula: Qin=1200 m3/s; Qout=900 m3/s; days=30; dS=(Qin-Qout)*days*86400=777600000 m3
models.boundary: 固定月平均流量且忽略蒸發取水，未驗證可用庫容~constant monthly mean flows with evaporation and withdrawals omitted; available capacity is not verified

models.title: 梯級變流到達~Cascade release wave arrival
models.boundary: 固定波速的單一路徑估算，不含衰減及反射~single-path estimate with constant wave celerity, excluding attenuation and reflection

models.title: 密度界面流態~Density interface flow regime
models.boundary: 雙層近似與已假定厚度尺度，未描述連續密度剖面~two-layer approximation with an assumed thickness scale, not a continuous density profile

models.title: 岸坡位移速率~Abutment slope movement rate
models.formula: x1=12 mm; x2=17 mm; dt=8 day; v=(x2-x1)/dt=0.625 mm/day
models.boundary: 單方向區間平均速率，不是警戒門檻或破壞時間預測~single-direction interval mean rate, not an alarm threshold or failure-time prediction

models.title: 高壩水壓投影~High dam pressure projection
models.formula: gamma=9.81 kN/m3; h=260 m; w=1 m; F=0.5*gamma*h*h*w=331578 kN
models.boundary: 垂直矩形投影條帶的靜水合力，不含尾水與動水壓~hydrostatic resultant on a vertical rectangular projected strip, excluding tailwater and hydrodynamic pressure

models.title: 薄拱圈膜力尺度~Thin arch ring membrane scale
models.formula: p=2 MPa; R=180 m; t=12 m; sigma=p*R/t=30 MPa
models.boundary: 理想薄圓環均勻徑向壓力，R/t=15；僅教學膜壓應力尺度~ideal thin circular ring under uniform radial pressure with R/t=15; a teaching membrane-compression scale only

models.title: 雙滑面岩楔抗力~Two plane wedge resistance
models.formula: N1=30 MN; U1=6 MN; mu1=0.6 (dimensionless); N2=20 MN; U2=4 MN; mu2=0.5 (dimensionless); R=mu1*(N1-U1)+mu2*(N2-U2)=22.4 MN
models.boundary: 兩面摩擦皆沿同一假想抗滑方向且正向力已知，無黏聚及錨索~both friction contributions act along one assumed resistance direction with known normal forces, no cohesion or anchors

models.title: 錨索長期力保留~Long term anchor force retention
models.formula: F0=3000 kN; r1=0.05 (dimensionless); r2=0.08 (dimensionless); F=F0*(1-r1)*(1-r2)=2622 kN
models.boundary: 兩個假想依序比例損失，並非現地錨索長期衰減定律~two assumed sequential proportional losses, not a field law for anchor deterioration

models.title: 挑流水舌射程~Ski jump jet travel
models.boundary: 水平初速且初始垂直速度為零的真空拋體，忽略水舌破碎~horizontal launch with zero initial vertical velocity in a drag-free projectile model, excluding jet breakup

models.title: 水舌衝擊壓力尺度~Jet impact pressure scale
models.boundary: 單相速度的動壓尺度，不是沖刷坑底實測峰值~dynamic-pressure scale for single-phase velocity, not a measured plunge-pool bottom peak

models.title: 壩塊自由收縮~Dam block free contraction
models.formula: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=20 m; dTcool=15 K; shortening=alpha*L*dTcool*1000=3 mm
models.boundary: 均勻降溫的自由收縮幅度，不含相鄰塊體與約束~free-shortening magnitude for uniform cooling, excluding neighboring blocks and restraint

models.title: 分層交換位能~Stratified exchange potential energy

models.boundary: 上輕下重兩等體積水團交換位置的位能增加，忽略混合耗散~potential-energy increase from swapping equal light-upper and dense-lower volumes, excluding mixing dissipation

models.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度~Stored water energy scale

models.boundary: 固定淨水頭效率且假設全量經機組，不含其他用途與時序限制~fixed net head and efficiency with all water passing through turbines, excluding other uses and timing constraints

models.title: 相關監測聯合殘差~Correlated monitoring residuals
models.formula: z1=2 (dimensionless); z2=2 (dimensionless); r=0.8 (dimensionless); D2=(z1*z1-2*r*z1*z2+z2*z2)/(1-r*r)=4.444444444

models.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度~Columnar joint series compliance

models.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升~Low heat cement adiabatic rise

models.boundary: 假定指定齡期放熱全被保留的絕熱估算，不含散熱及水化動力學~adiabatic estimate retaining all stated age-specific heat, excluding heat loss and hydration kinetics

models.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩~Gigawatt unit shaft torque

models.title: 發電端電流尺度~Generator terminal current scale

models.title: 通風散熱體積流~Ventilation cooling volume flow

models.title: 調速下垂靜態尺度~Governor droop static scale

models.title: 摻氣體積分率~Aeration volume fraction

models.title: 水工模型尺度律~Hydraulic model scaling law

models.boundary: 長度比為原型除模型，重力相同的福祿流量尺度~length ratio is prototype divided by model with equal gravity and Froude discharge scaling

models.title: 獨立量測加權估計~Independent measurement weighted estimate
models.boundary: 獨立無偏高斯量測的加權平均，未處理共同漂移~weighted mean for independent unbiased Gaussian observations, excluding shared drift

models.title: 視在容量與無功~Apparent capacity and reactive power
models.formula: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar

models.title: 轉子旋轉儲能~Rotor rotational stored energy
models.boundary: 剛性等效轉子且慣量固定，未計水柱動能與控制作用~rigid equivalent rotor with fixed inertia, excluding water-column energy and controls

models.title: 風機轉速與耗能~Fan speed and power
models.formula: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW

models.boundary: 三相相同相電流與每相運轉溫度電阻，未含其他損失~equal phase currents and per-phase resistance at operating temperature, excluding other losses

models.title: 軸承油熱容量~Bearing oil thermal storage
models.formula: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ
